limitations.description: Complex engineering and energy estimates are preliminary pilot estimates and require expert review before contractual use.
Marketplace, RFQ, warehouse, and payment workflows are outside this pilot-launch readiness gate.
This gate does not start a public release, native build, EAS build, production database migration, or destructive migration.
The agent may report technical readiness only. Final owner go/no-go remains PENDING_OWNER_REVIEW until a real owner artifact is supplied.
